_note: Prompts for hooks/rewrite-prompt.sh, written for this test (none taken from bench/head-to-head/tasks.json). related: asks to rewrite or edit existing prose; the hook must add its line. unrelated: anything else; the hook must print nothing. known_miss: related prompts the hook does not catch, a documented limit. The prompts came in four batches of 32+32, 20+20, 15+15 and 12+12; each later batch was measured before the patterns were tuned on it: 10/20, 8/15 and 5/12 related caught (23/47, 49 percent) and 2/20, 1/15 and 1/12 unrelated flagged (4/47). The full fixture is therefore in-sample and its rate overstates recall on new phrasings.
